title: Overview: the big ideas
summary: The chapter's key concepts and how its sections fit together.

blocks.md: Welcome to **Conclusion** (Vol I). This overview gives you the chapter's big ideas before the section-by-section lessons. Read the claims once, flip the flashcards, then take the warm-up quiz: it is fine to miss questions here, the lessons that follow fill the gaps.

A single production decision travels through the entire stack. A data pipeline decides which events count as training signal. That signal shapes the architecture, which in turn fixes memory footprint and arithmetic intensity. Those properties constrain hardware choice, quantization strategy, serving latency, drift monitoring, and governance obligations. Mastered individually, each layer represents a valuable skill; mastered together, they confer the ability to reason across boundaries that no single specialty sees in full.
